notes.title: v1.0.3 Minor Update
notes.content: [p]• Improved the loading times between scene swaps. (Example: from level select to level 1, from level 1 to level select).[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Minor Update
notes.content:
• Fixed a bug where the game would save itself over a game slot at incorrect times.

• Minor upgrades to the physics interpolation of the camera.

• Minor upgrades to how the game closes down (exits). (Improved game exit time).

notes.title: version_1.0.1 update
notes.content: Small patch for the black fade transition effect when swapping from scene to scene. (Example: from level select scene to level 1 scene; from level 1 scene to level select scene).
